caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing and facing forward, wearing a cream-colored dress with horizontal ruffled layers and a light blue bandeau at the hem adorned with small decorative bows or rosettes. She has a matching cream-colored capelet or short cloak over her shoulders, tied at the neck with a large bow. Her sleeves and the front of her bodice are decorated with blue ribbon accents and small floral embellishments. On her head, she wears a tall cream bonnet with blue ribbon decorations and additional cream adornments at the top, partially framing her curled reddish hair. She holds a bunch of yellow flowers in her left hand and an umbrella or parasol draped in matching cream fabric in her right hand. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, placing focus on the figure and her attire.
title: Corn Husk Doll
